title: Disaster Recovery Plan
summary: Synthetic disaster recovery plan. The planted findings are that the plan was last tested three years ago and has no documented cloud failover.

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: This plan covers restoration of Acme Corp's customer-facing platform, internal support systems, and operational reporting systems after a major outage.

sections.title: Recovery objectives
sections.content: The target recovery time objective for the customer-facing platform is 24 hours. The target recovery point objective is four hours for production databases and 24 hours for internal reporting systems.

sections.title: Test history
sections.content: The last full disaster recovery exercise was completed on 2022-03-18. No full failover test was completed in 2023 or 2024. A tabletop exercise was proposed for 2025 but has not yet been scheduled.

sections.title: Recovery strategy
sections.content: The current recovery strategy restores database backups into the primary cloud region after incident containment. The plan does not document automated cloud-region failover, warm standby infrastructure, or a tested secondary-region cutover procedure.

sections.title: Communications
sections.content: The incident commander is responsible for internal updates every two hours during a disaster recovery event. Customer communications are coordinated by Support and Legal.
